search.hintTitle: Search everything you may see — mail, WhatsApp, documents, photos, calendar, tasks, contacts, recordings, letters.

helpPanel.loadFailed: This help page couldn't be loaded.
helpPanel.pickTopic: Pick a topic, or ask Yorik in your own words.

hint.calendar: Tap a day or + to add an appointment. Everyone has their own colour.
hint.tasks: Type a to-do at the top. Tick the box when it's done.
hint.chat: Talk to Yorik like to a person: it adds dates, finds papers and writes letters.
hint.docs: Drop a letter or bill here, or take a photo of one. Yorik reads and files it.
hint.email: Your inbox. Yorik sorts it and suggests replies; nothing goes out without you.
hint.photos: Your family's photos. How to back up this phone's pictures: tap ? below.
hint.board: Everyone's day at a glance. Tap your own tasks to tick them.
hint.contacts: Everyone Yorik knows. Yorik uses this to find addresses and numbers.
hint.whatsapp: Your WhatsApp chats. Yorik can suggest replies; you decide what's sent.
hint.compose: Letters, invoices and forms from templates. Or ask Yorik to write one.
hint.write: Write a letter on your letterhead. Yorik helps with the wording.
hint.briefing: Your day in one page: dates, to-dos and what came in.
hint.finance: Your bank account, sorted by what the money went to. Read-only.
hint.pipelines: Yorik keeps an eye on things for you, like waiting for an answer to a mail.
hint.recordings: Record a conversation; Yorik writes down what was said and agreed.

ask.title: Ask Yorik
ask.text: Tap here and type or say what you need: "Remind me tomorrow at 9 to call the doctor."

family.title: Your family today
family.text: Everyone's face and what their day holds. Tap a face to open the family board.

checklist.title: A few steps left
checklist.text: This list helps you finish setting up. It waits until you're ready.

dock.title: Your apps
dock.text: Every app lives down here. The colours stay the same everywhere.

help.title: Stuck?
help.text: Tap the question mark for help on the page you're on, or just ask Yorik "how does this work?"

error.title: Something broke
error.body: The page hit a render error. Try Reset; if it keeps happening, copy the details below to share with Yorik maintainers.
